text: And all the congregation{H5712} of the children{H1121} of Israel{H3478} journeyed{H5265} from the wilderness{H4057} of Sin,{H5512} by their journeys,{H4550} according to the commandment{H6310} of Jehovah,{H3068} and encamped{H2583} in Rephidim:{H7508} and there was no water{H4325} for the people{H5971} to drink.{H8354}
